source.attribution: Eric Bruneton, Precomputed Atmospheric Scattering; SceneGIS flat-slab adaptation

scattering.mapping: x=32 signedSquare(sunZenithCosine) blocks by 8 linear scatteringCosine samples, y=signedSquare(viewZenithCosine), z=squareRoot(height/top)
scattering.alpha: unused; stores total RGB red for deterministic RGBA packing

transport.segmentRule: intersect untruncated geometric ray with slab and retain the complete visible segment

quadrature.angularRule: Gauss-Legendre split at the horizon, periodic azimuth

transport.scatteringDensity: real cosine spherical harmonics; separate normalized Rayleigh and Cornette-Shanks Mie phase convolution; direction-resolved orders 2-4
transport.runtimeEvaluation: true-boundary entry/endpoint radiance differencing with analytic segment transmittance
transport.boundaryEvaluation: optical-depth quadrature to the true slab boundary or binary16 transmittance floor; exact horizontal uses semi-infinite optical limit
transport.segmentTransmittance: runtime analytic Rayleigh/Mie/ozone optical depth over the complete visible segment
transport.groundBoundary: order n includes transmittance-to-ground times Lambert albedo/pi times ground irradiance of order n-2 (direct for n=2, cosine-weighted single-order atmospheric diffuse thereafter); scattering stores atmospheric paths only, and the final visible ground reflection is applied once at runtime
